qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global premium confectionery brand equity, proprietary conching technology, and vertical integration including 500+ proprietary retail boutiques. High pricing power proved by pushing +19% price increases in 2025 with expanding EBIT margins (16.4%) despite historic cocoa commodity spikes.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Unrivaled Lindy premium confectionery brand with global pricing power and expanding retail network. Raised prices 19% in 2025 to fully offset historic cocoa inflation while growing EBIT 9.8% to CHF 971M. Fortress balance sheet with net debt under 0.8x net income and 18.7x interest coverage. [5-10Y g: volume/mix 2.0% + pricing power 3.5% + retail expansion 1.5% - cocoa cost volatility 0.5% + share repurchases 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 14.6%, and operating ROIC is 19.5%. Multi-year Owner FCF conversion is 80.6%. In FY25, organic sales grew 12.4% driven by +19.0% pricing power with volume down only -6.6%, while EBIT margins expanded to 16.4%. Owner EPS compounded at 7.37% CAGR peak-to-peak (CHF 253.4 in 2022 to CHF 313.7 in 2025). Net debt of CHF 562.8M is fully covered by CHF 727.2M net income (0.77x ratio) with interest coverage of 18.7x.
